cost_unit: output_tokens_reported_per_subagent (no USD figure exposed by the runtime in this session)

notes: Tokens are the per-subagent token counts reported by the Agent tool for the two lane subagents only.
The one-time surface-diagnosis agent (claude-code-guide, 37813 tokens) is NOT counted as pilot lane cost; it was setup/triage, not lane work.

Lead/orchestration tokens (this main session writing packets and evidence) are not separately metered by the runtime and are excluded; coordinator-labor.json captures lead effort qualitatively instead.

team_arm.how_to_capture: In the Terminal team session, run /cost (or read the session cost summary) immediately after both teammates close their lane tasks, and record total tokens + USD if shown into team-arm-kit/evidence-template/cost-report.json.

comparison.go_no_go_rule: No default adoption if team-arm cost exceeds the subagent baseline by more than 25 percent without a justified quality win.
comparison.note: The subagent arm is the cost baseline. The comparison completes only after the Terminal team arm fills its cost figure.
